details: Analysis of this package version produced no static-rule matches and no traced code evidence of exfiltration, install-time remote code execution, silent-relay, credential theft, backdoor, or self-propagation. The scanned files show no lifecycle hooks fetching or executing attacker-controlled content, no hardcoded C2 destinations bound to network sinks, and no reads of installer secret paths.
